name: 1S-LSD
summary: 1S-LSD, also known as 1-(3-(trimethylsilyl)propionyl)-LSD, is a psychedelic drug of the lysergamide family related to lysergic acid diethylamide (LSD). It is the trimethylsilyl derivative of 1P-LSD and functions as a prodrug and functional analogue of LSD. 1S-LSD was developed in response to legal restrictions on similar compounds, such as 1D-LSD, which were banned in Germany under the NpSG law in June 2024.

pharmacology.text: While specific studies on 1S-LSD are limited due to its recent introduction, it is presumed to share pharmacological properties with LSD and its analogues. These substances typically act as partial agonists at serotonin receptors, particularly the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor, which is responsible for their hallucinogenic effects.

summaryZh: 1S-LSD（學名：1-(3-三甲基矽基丙醯基)麥角酸二乙醯胺) 是一種有機矽化合物，化學式為C26H37N3O2Si。它是一種精神藥物，為LSD的前體藥物和功能類似物。

uses.en: It has been sold as a designer drug, made to fall outside laws that cover other LSD relatives.
uses.zh: 它作為設計師藥物販售，其設計是為了避開涵蓋其他LSD衍生物的法規。
uses.zhHans: 它作为设计师药物贩售，其设计是为了避开涵盖其他LSD衍生物的法规。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its trimethylsilyl group contains a silicon atom, which is very rare in drugs, since almost all medicines are built only from carbon, hydrogen, oxygen, nitrogen and a few others.
fact.zh: 它的三甲基矽基含有一個矽原子，這在藥物中非常罕見，因為幾乎所有藥物都只由碳、氫、氧、氮及少數其他元素構成。
fact.zhHans: 它的三甲基硅基含有一个硅原子，这在药物中非常罕见，因为几乎所有药物都只由碳、氢、氧、氮及少数其他元素构成。
